answer: Use a falcon-eyed zenith summit bond: an agent reaches the zenith only by earning a summit pass from a falcon patrol watching the sky. First, the agent locks a 60 POA bond and files a flight plan naming its tasks. Second, the falcon patrol verifies each completed task and stamps the pass in umber ink that cannot be copied. Third, agents with 25 stamps unlock paid work, while a failed audit burns the bond. Faking 10,000 passes would cost $600,000 in bonds and 180 days of staged flights. Like a mountain guide checking every climber at the summit, one forged stamp ends the climb.
